purpose: Additive non-Mundarica source-discovery records. These are verified source leads or catalogue/dataset records, not extracted cultural claims and not proof of unrestricted redistribution or commercial reuse.

records.title: A descriptive analysis of Mundari
records.author: Walter Anthony Cook, S.J.
records.notes: Glottolog verifies a Georgetown University dissertation of vi + 315 pages (with illustrations/maps) describing Mundari sound, meaning and grammar. Register as a bibliographic source lead; any substantive linguistic statement requires exact page-level evidence from an authorized copy before public factual use.
records.rights_note: Bibliographic metadata visibility does not establish permission to redistribute the dissertation or use its full text commercially.

records.title: Mundari: The Myth of a Language Without Word Classes
records.publisher: Linguistic Typology / Walter de Gruyter; Glottolog bibliographic record
records.author: Nicholas Evans and Toshiki Osada
records.notes: Glottolog verifies the article in Linguistic Typology 9(3), pages 351–390, DOI 10.1515/lity.2005.9.3.351. It is relevant to Mundari morphosyntax and word-class analysis. Article conclusions are not promoted into MLHKP cultural or linguistic claims without passage-level evidence.
records.rights_note: Glottolog metadata does not transfer copyright or reuse rights in the De Gruyter article.

records.title: Mundari Ideophones
records.publisher: PARADISEC / Australian National University research repository
records.author: Bonnie McLean
records.notes: ANU repository metadata identifies PARADISEC collection BMM1, focused on Mundari ideophones and their use in discourse, song and narrative, with Hasada/India keywords and DOI 10.4225/72/585bea79cf9dd. Register as a dataset/audio discovery lead; individual recordings, consultants and annotations require item-level consent/access review before ingestion.
records.rights_note: Repository metadata reports CC BY-SA 4.0 for the collection; MLHKP must still preserve item-level access, participant/consultant conditions and culturally sensitive restrictions before reuse.

records.title: Proposal to Encode the Nag Mundari Script in the Universal Character Set
records.author: Lawrence Wolf-Sonkin and Biswajit Mandal
records.notes: Unicode document L2/21-031R, dated 23 April 2021, is a 38-page proposal for encoding Nag Mundari. It documents script naming, character repertoire and background. Historical or sociolinguistic statements inside the proposal remain source-reported statements until corroborated and evidence-linked.
records.rights_note: Public Unicode access permits citation and technical reference; reuse of document content and embedded third-party material remains subject to applicable Unicode and source rights.

records.title: MunTTS: A Text-to-Speech System for Mundari
records.author: Varun Gumma; Rishav Hada; Aditya Yadavalli; Pamir Gogoi; Ishani Mondal; Vivek Seshadri; Kalika Bali
records.notes: ACL Anthology verifies the ComputEL-7 paper, pages 76–82, DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.computel-1.11. The paper reports collection and processing of Mundari text and speech for TTS and native-speaker evaluation. Dataset-level records and participant conditions must be registered separately before any data ingestion.
records.rights_note: ACL Anthology states post-2016 materials are CC BY 4.0; this does not automatically grant rights to separately released datasets, recordings, model checkpoints or participant data.

records.title: MunTTS official codebase and dataset-access record
records.publisher: Microsoft Research / GitHub; dataset collaboration with Karya
records.author: MunTTS project authors
records.notes: The archived official repository identifies the codebase for MunTTS and states that the full Mundari dataset and model checkpoints must be requested from Karya. Register as a software/dataset-access lead, not as acquired data.
